title: Create a MoneyHelper app
description: Scaffold a Next.js Pages Router app under apps/<name> to the repo conventions and register it in the pipeline, PR title, Sonar and editor config files.

name.description: The app name in kebab-case, for example savings-calculator. Becomes the folder apps/<name> and the Nx project name.
name.x-prompt: What name would you like to use for the app (kebab-case)?

port.description: Dev server port written to project.json and netlify.toml. Defaults to the lowest port from 4300 that no other project uses.

e2e.description: Also generate the Playwright e2e project at apps/e2e/<name>-e2e and its pipeline job.

netlifySiteId.description: The Netlify site id (UUID) for the app. When omitted the site id registrations are skipped and listed as manual steps.

examples.description: Preview the files that would be created and updated
Create apps/savings-goal and apps/e2e/savings-goal-e2e on the next free port
Pick the port, register the Netlify site id and skip the e2e project
